summary: Independent-verification-only phase. Independently re-derived and adversarially attacked Phase 137I.1's pending_push finalization-ordering repair (closed blockers_are_push_state_only classifier, non-authoritative pending_push canonical-report state, case-insensitive phase-identity fix) from primary sources and live behavior, not from 137I.1's own report/tests as an oracle. Live-exercised finalize_phase_report(allow_pending_push=True) and _classify_bootstrap_readiness in isolated fixtures independent of 137I.1's own test file; grepped every report_completeness consumer in src/pcae (14 files) for authority-boundary violations and found none reachable. Found and repaired one live, independently demonstrated NON-BLOCKING defect: a residual instance of the same regex-truncation bug class 137I.1 fixed at five sibling patterns was missed at phase_reports.py lines 1224-1225 (_check_canonical_metadata_consistency's summary-parsing regexes), producing a false recommended_next_phase mismatch -- and a false report_completeness downgrade to partial -- for any legitimate report whose free-text summary names a dotted-and-lettered next-phase id (e.g. 137I.1V, this very phase's own id). The defect was contained by the closed classifier (metadata_consistency is not a push-state field, so it was never reachable as an authority bypass via the pending-push escape) but could wrongly block/downgrade normal finalization. Repaired with a 2-line regex fix; reproduced live before and after; 4 new regression tests added. Recorded one NON-BLOCKING, DEFERRED observation for a future phase: session.py's _classify_bootstrap_readiness does not specially label pending_push (relies only on partial/incomplete completeness checks), and _phase_is_completed() has a pre-existing, 137I.1-unrelated self-referential argument bug (compares the latest report's own phase_id to itself rather than to the active task's phase). Verdict: VERIFIED AFTER REPAIR. No Blocking finding. No trust gate weakened. Runtime unchanged throughout: Observed / observe / unavailable. Full report in docs/PHASE_137I1V_FINALIZATION_ORDERING_DEADLOCK_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
